name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, TLS, and service management. Also applies host security controls such as Fail2ban, UFW rules, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, creates Redis logging directories, configures the Redis listener and authentication, and applies the required Redis configuration behavior.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment, configures the application and database, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
